## Pull request overview This PR migrates the udp_bridge package from the legacy rosdoc documentation system to rosdoc2, the modern ROS 2 documentation generation tool. The changes include configuration files for Sphinx and Doxygen integration, updated package metadata, and enhanced documentation content. **Changes:** - Replaced legacy rosdoc.yaml with rosdoc2.yaml configuration for modern documentation generation - Added Sphinx documentation infrastructure (conf.py, index.rst, conceptual_overview.md) with Breathe/Exhale integration for C++ API documentation - Updated README.md with standardized structure including installation instructions, usage examples, and comprehensive API reference tables ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | udp_bridge/rosdoc2.yaml | New rosdoc2 configuration file defining Doxygen and Sphinx builders for API documentation | | udp_bridge/rosdoc.yaml | Removed legacy rosdoc configuration file | | udp_bridge/package.xml | Updated export tag to reference rosdoc2.yaml instead of rosdoc.yaml | | udp_bridge/doc/index.rst | New Sphinx documentation index with table of contents | | udp_bridge/doc/conf.py | Sphinx configuration with Breathe/Exhale setup for C++ documentation and ReadTheDocs theme | | udp_bridge/doc/conceptual_overview.md | New comprehensive architecture and design documentation | | udp_bridge/README.md | Enhanced with standardized sections for installation, usage, node API, and parameters |
